id: Kompres banyak file sekaligus: "Satu file per file asal" menyimpan tiap file sendiri di folder pilihan, dengan batas ukuran masing-masing.
Potong halaman dan sensor (kotak hitam) di pratinjau. Halaman bersensor disimpan sebagai gambar supaya teks di bawahnya benar-benar hilang.
OCR dengan mesin bawaan Windows: hasil pindai bisa dicari dan disalin. Perjelas foto dokumen dari ponsel.
Grid bisa dipakai dengan keyboard: panah, Shift+panah, Alt+panah untuk memindah halaman, Home, End.
en: Compress many files at once: "One file per source file" saves each file on its own in the folder you pick, each with its own size limit.
Crop pages and redact (black boxes) in the preview. Redacted pages are saved as images so the text under them is really gone.
OCR with the engine built into Windows: scans become searchable and copyable. Clean up phone photos of documents.
The page grid works from the keyboard: arrows, Shift+arrows, Alt+arrows to move pages, Home, End.
